bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" ls "$GCP_BQ_DATASET" 2>&1 | head; echo "---"; bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" show "$GCP_BQ_DATASET" 2>&1 | head

bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=prettyjson "
SELECT
  CORR(f1,label) AS corr_f1,
  CORR(f2,label) AS corr_f2,
  CORR(f3,label) AS corr_f3,
  CORR(f4,label) AS corr_f4,
  CORR(f5,label) AS corr_f5,
  CORR(f6,label) AS corr_f6,
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  SUM(label) AS pos
FROM \`$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}_training_data\`
" 2>&1

TABLE="$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}_training_data"
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=prettyjson "SELECT CORR(f1,label) AS c1, CORR(f2,label) AS c2, CORR(f3,label) AS c3, CORR(f4,label) AS c4, CORR(f5,label) AS c5, CORR(f6,label) AS c6, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(label) AS pos FROM $TABLE" 2>&1

TABLE="$GCP_PROJECT.$GCP_BQ_DATASET.${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}_training_data"
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=prettyjson "SELECT label, MIN(f1) AS min_f1, MAX(f1) AS max_f1, AVG(f1) AS avg_f1, COUNT(*) AS n FROM $TABLE GROUP BY label ORDER BY label" 2>&1
echo "--- accuracy of simple threshold f1>1 ---"
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=prettyjson "SELECT COUNTIF((f1>1.0)=(label=1))/COUNT(*) AS acc_f1_thresh FROM $TABLE" 2>&1
